label: Mattermost

sensitivePaths.label: Delete a message or a channel

agentGuide: Base path /api/v4. Me: GET /api/v4/users/me; my teams: GET /api/v4/users/me/teams; channels of a team: GET /api/v4/users/me/teams/<team_id>/channels; by name: GET /api/v4/teams/name/<team>/channels/name/<channel>. Read: GET /api/v4/channels/<channel_id>/posts?per_page=30 (order[] then posts{} by id; message, user_id, create_at); search: POST /api/v4/teams/<team_id>/posts/search {"terms": "..."}. Write: POST /api/v4/posts {"channel_id": "...", "message": "..."} (root_id to reply in a thread). Direct message: POST /api/v4/channels/direct ["my_id", "their_id"] then post to the returned channel. Users: GET /api/v4/users/username/<name>, GET /api/v4/users?per_page=50. Markdown works in messages. The token is set by Allkin.
